summary: User reported that approximately 3000 USD held in a Telegram Wallet account became inaccessible after the service froze the account and requested additional AML and KYC documentation. The funds remained locked while the user was unable to satisfy the requested verification requirements.
user_mistake: Held funds on a custodial platform subject to AML and KYC restrictions
prevention: Understand withdrawal and compliance requirements before using custodial services / Avoid storing significant funds on platforms with unresolved verification status
